before.sponsors: House Ways and Means Committee; Senate Education, Energy, and the Environment Committee
before.key_provisions: Authorizes Maryland Longitudinal Data System Center external data sharing with third-party data centers for multistate reporting; not a siting moratorium.

after.sponsors: Chair, House Ways and Means Committee (departmental request); Chair, Senate Education, Energy, and the Environment Committee (departmental request)
after.status: HB0293 approved 2026-04-14 as Chapter 100; SB0056 approved 2026-04-14 as Chapter 101. Each specifies 2026-07-01 as its original effective date.
after.key_provisions: The enacted chapters authorize limited sharing of student and workforce data with a secure third-party computational research platform for multistate research and reporting; this is not a data-center infrastructure restriction.

before.status: Died in committee, both chambers (no vote after hearings; SB0596 hearing rescheduled to 3/5); Sine Die 2026-04-13
before.key_provisions: Large load customer interconnection and demand response program; would create interconnection process and prioritization provisions for certain large loads.

after.status: House last recorded action 2026-02-10 scheduled a 2026-02-24 hearing; the final 2026 index lists the hearing stage, indicating non-enactment in that session.
after.key_provisions: First reading proposed interconnection and demand-response rules for large-load customers with monthly demand of at least 25 MW and load factor above 80%, including a 25% capacity contribution with a surplus-interconnection offset, expedited processing for 100% capacity, and priority requiring 100% capacity and prevailing wages.
